intro: From 13 articles published between April 10 and July 31, 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of macOS documents nine high-severity incidents, one critical, and two medium. Lazarus Group, ClickFix, and Sapphire Sleet were observed in campaigns affecting technology, cryptocurrency, artificial-intelligence, finance, and individual users across Global, Asia, Europe, North America, and South Asia. Key vulnerabilities include CVE-2024-54529 and CVE-2025-31235. These reports highlight targeted exploitation and social engineering tactics, with the affected sectors and regions reflecting the broad reach of macOS-focused attacks during this period.
